utterances.speaker: A
utterances.transcript: Good afternoon, everyone. Today we'll review the project timeline, the budget and the test results.

utterances.speaker: B
utterances.transcript: 大家下午好。好的，我们先看一下项目进度表，然后再讨论预算。

utterances.speaker: A
utterances.transcript: I'm thrilled to report that the new dashboard passed every test, and the pilot users absolutely love it!

utterances.speaker: B
utterances.transcript: 太好了！听到这个消息我们非常高兴，团队都很兴奋，大家一直在期待这一天！

utterances.speaker: B
utterances.transcript: 非常感谢你们的耐心和专业，在整个项目过程中给了我们很大的帮助，我们由衷地感激。

utterances.speaker: A
utterances.transcript: Thank you so much for your trust and for the extra support last month. We truly appreciate everything you did for us.

utterances.speaker: A
utterances.transcript: Honestly, I'm really frustrated. We've sent the same bug report three times, and every time we get the same answer: 'we're looking into it.'

utterances.speaker: B
utterances.transcript: 说实话，我们已经非常受挫了。同样的需求我们解释了三遍，你们每次还是做错，这样反复折腾让人精疲力尽，真的受够了！

utterances.speaker: B
utterances.transcript: 这完全不能接受！你们承诺上周五交付，结果什么都没有！如果再延误，我们就终止合同，并要求赔偿！

utterances.speaker: A
utterances.transcript: How dare you blame us! You changed the requirements five times, and now you threaten to cancel? This is outrageous, and I'm furious!

utterances.speaker: A
utterances.transcript: I'm extremely worried. If the server migration fails tonight, we could lose all the customer data, and I can't stop thinking about the consequences.

utterances.speaker: B
utterances.transcript: 我非常担心，也很紧张。如果明天上午系统还不能上线，我们的客户就会流失，我整晚都睡不着觉。

utterances.speaker: A
utterances.transcript: I'm sorry to share this, but our lead engineer is leaving the company next month. It makes me sad, he has been with us for ten years.

utterances.speaker: B
utterances.transcript: 听到这个消息我很难过。我们和他合作了这么多年，真的舍不得他离开，心里很失落。

utterances.speaker: A
utterances.transcript: We need your decision immediately! The release window closes in one hour, so please approve the update right now!

utterances.speaker: B
utterances.transcript: 请马上回复！客户的演示会议十分钟后就要开始了，我们急需你们发送最终版本，一刻也不能耽误！

utterances.speaker: B
utterances.transcript: 有点遗憾，交付日期又改了，不过我觉得我们还是可以协调好的。

utterances.speaker: A
utterances.transcript: I'm a little nervous about the new security audit, but I'm confident we can get through it together.
